description: Ready-to-paste install snippets for one MCP server, for every client we support. An MCPB bundle has no launch command, so it returns the download URL, the registry's SHA-256 and commands to verify the file instead. Read get_server first: this returns configuration, not a safety judgement.

component.description: Which channel to report on when a server ships several.

identifier.description: Package name, endpoint URL, registry name or verifymcp slug.

name: get_server_install_config

bundle.description: MCPB bundles only (null otherwise): the file to download, the SHA-256 the registry declares for it, and commands that check the download against it. Open the verified file with an MCPB-capable host such as Claude Desktop.

fileName.description: File name the verify commands expect the download to be saved as.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 the registry declares for the file; null when it declares none, so there is nothing to verify against.

verify.description: Commands that check the downloaded file against sha256. Empty when sha256 is null.

context.description: What we know about the server being installed. Present whenever a server resolved, including when no snippets could be built; null only when the identifier matched nothing.

claimed.description: Owner has proved ownership of the listing.

malwareScan.description: confirmed: a vendor flagged this server. clean: a vendor assessed it and found nothing. not_scanned: nobody assessed it, which is NOT an all-clear.

publisherClass.description: official, verified, third_party or unknown. unknown means no proof, not disproof.

score.description: Trust score 0-100; null when never scored.

url.description: Canonical page carrying the full report.

verdict.description: Worst category verdict. unverified means we could not determine it, NOT that it failed.

body.description: The snippet itself. Use verbatim; never re-escape it.

client.description: Client id, e.g. claude, cursor, vscode.

comment.description: Leading comment line, e.g. where the block goes.

note.description: Caveat for this client, where the syntax is a convention rather than a guarantee.

notice.description: How to narrow a truncated result, or why an empty one is empty; null when neither applies.

source.description: Canonical verifymcp.io page for this result.

title: Get MCP server install config
